_meta.excludes: Income year 2025 lives in constants.json and is NOT duplicated here. The estimator loads 2025 from constants.json and 2022-2024 from this file.
_meta.purpose: Retro-audit engine: recompute already-filed past returns (2022-2024) to find recoverable money (missed PPR / rent / health / IRS Jovem). Each year-set is independently source-cited so a retro recomputation stands on the law as it actually stood that year, never on the current year's numbers.
_meta.provenance: Every value below was confirmed against a public authoritative source fetched during the 2026-07-10 research run: AT (Autoridade Tributaria) official folhetos for IRS Jovem 2022/2023/2024 (info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt and mirror at.madeira.gov.pt / iseg.ulisboa.pt), Lei 33/2024 and Lei 32/2024 (Assembleia da Republica), and cross-corroborating practitioner tables (Doutor Financas, economiafinancas.com, Montepio, PwC). Structural knowledge of public tax law only; zero proprietary code.
_meta.unknown_contract: Any value that could not be confirmed this run is stored as the literal string "UNKNOWN". The estimator REFUSES to compute a path that depends on an UNKNOWN value and raises a clear error naming the year and field, rather than guessing. As of this build, all load-bearing values below are CONFIRMED; no UNKNOWN blocks are active.

verification_tiers.brackets: CONFIRMED per year: two independent sources each (2022 Doutor Financas + economiafinancas; 2023 Doutor Financas + ACIAB; 2024 economiafinancas Aug-2024 final table + internal consistency with the already-gated 2025 constants, which state 2024 rates == 2025 rates and 2024 1st-bracket ceiling 7703 -> 8059 in 2025).
verification_tiers.ias: CONFIRMED: DGAEP / Diario da Republica / apcmc (2022=443.20 Port. 294/2021; 2023=480.43 Port. 298/2022; 2024=509.26 Port. 421/2023).
verification_tiers.categoria_a_specific_deduction: CONFIRMED: 2022 & 2023 = 4104.00 (frozen >decade); 2024 = 4350.24 (Lei 32/2024, de 7 de agosto; +6% == IAS update rate). Sources: Montepio, ECO, Doutor Financas, acontabilista.pt.
verification_tiers.rent_cap: CONFIRMED per year (this is the cap that MOVED): 2022=502, 2023=502, 2024=600. Sources: idealista/CGD/Montepio (2023 max was 502), Publico OE2024 (raised to 600 for 2024). Earlier stray '550 for 2023' was a non-adopted figure; explicit sources confirm 502 held for 2023.
verification_tiers.global_cap: CONFIRMED structure (Art. 78 n.7 CIRS, stable statute): uncapped below the 1st-bracket ceiling; tapered 2500->1000 between the 1st and last(8th) bracket ceilings; flat 1000 above. Endpoints AUTO-TRACK each year's Art. 68 bracket ceilings, so they are taken from this file's own bracket rows.
verification_tiers.irs_jovem: CONFIRMED from the AT official folhetos IRS Jovem 2022, 2023, 2024 (verbatim schedules + euro caps read this run). The regime changed MATERIALLY each year - see irs_jovem.regime_note per year.
verification_tiers.other_deduction_caps: REASONED-STABLE (health 15%/1000, education 30%/800 base, despesas gerais 35%/250, PPR 20% age-bands 400/350/300, dependent 600): these statutory caps held unchanged across 2022-2025; they were NOT independently re-fetched per year this run. Honesty flag: verification tier is 'stable-statute + 2025 cross-check', not 'per-year primary fetch'. Verify at Portal das Financas before quoting to a user near a filing deadline.

correction_paths._intro: Legal spine for turning a recomputation into recovered money. Each instrument confirmed this run against OCC guides, CPPT/LGT/CIRS and Doutor Financas 'como corrigir a declaracao de IRS'. Deadlines are outer bounds; specific facts can shorten them - route edge cases to an OCC.

declaracao_de_substituicao.what: Taxpayer re-files the Modelo 3 replacing the original; keeps the original submission date/identity.
declaracao_de_substituicao.window_in_taxpayer_favour: A declaracao de substituicao that LOWERS the tax (recovers money) may be filed within the reclamacao graciosa deadline; for a pure own-omission the practical channel is reclamacao graciosa / revisao. (CPPT art. 59.)
declaracao_de_substituicao.window_against_taxpayer: If it RAISES tax, it can be filed within 30 days of the filing deadline without penalty, or later within the reclamacao (120d) / impugnacao (90d) windows.
declaracao_de_substituicao.source: CPPT art. 59; OCC 'Modelo 3 - Substituicao'; Doutor Financas 'Como corrigir a declaracao de IRS'.

reclamacao_graciosa.counted_from: termo do prazo para pagamento do imposto (or, for own-declaration errors, the special 2-year window of CIRS art. 140).
reclamacao_graciosa.filed_at: Direcao de Financas competente, via e-Balcao no Portal das Financas (or in person).
reclamacao_graciosa.source: CPPT art. 70 (deadline), art. 102 (computation); CIRS art. 140 (IRS 2-year special); OCC Guia Pratico dos Graciosos 2023.

revisao_oficiosa.counted_from: a liquidacao (or a qualquer tempo se o tributo nao foi pago).
revisao_oficiosa.ground: erro imputavel aos servicos. A PURE voluntary omission of the taxpayer's own deduction is generally NOT 'erro imputavel aos servicos' - this longer window may be unavailable for simple forgotten-deduction cases; route contested cases to an OCC.
revisao_oficiosa.source: LGT art. 78 n.1; CAAD/STA jurisprudence on erro imputavel aos servicos.

caducidade.counted_from: o facto tributario (for IRS, from the end of the income year).
caducidade.effect: outer bound on the liquidation/correction; once elapsed the amount is time-barred and unrecoverable.

2022.legal_basis: Art. 68 CIRS as in force for 2022 income (9 escaloes, OE2022 desdobramento dos 3.o e 6.o escaloes).

ias_eur.source: IAS 2022 = 443.20 (Portaria n.o 294/2021, de 13 de dezembro); cited in the AT IRS Jovem 2022 folheto.

categoria_a_specific_deduction_eur.source: Deducao especifica cat. A frozen at 4104.00 for 2022 (Montepio, Doutor Financas, CGD); CIRS art. 25.

brackets.method: Art. 68 CIRS 2022. coleta computed cumulatively on marginal rates.
brackets.confirmation: CONFIRMED by two independent sources: Doutor Financas (escaloes-de-irs) and economiafinancas.com/2021/escaloes-irs-2022 - identical limits and taxa_normal.

global_cap.source: Art. 78 n.7 CIRS (endpoints track the 2022 1st and last Art. 68 ceilings).
global_cap.last_ceiling_note: Artigo 78.º n.º 7 c) fixes this endpoint as 'o valor mínimo do primeiro escalão do n.º 1 do artigo 68.º-A' = 80 000 EUR, estável desde a Lei 82-B/2014 (ver assets/law/irs68a.md). Corrigido 2026-07-24: este campo seguia o teto do 8.º escalão do artigo 68.º (75 009 em 2022, 78 834 em 2023, 80 000 em 2024) — um número de OUTRO artigo, que só por coincidência acertou em 2024.

rent_habitacao.note: 2022 base rent cap = 502 (this is the year-varying cap).

irs_jovem.regime_note: OE2022 version (art. 12-B CIRS, Lei 12/2022): 5-year schedule 30/30/20/20/10, LOW per-year euro caps (7.5/7.5/5/5/2.5 x IAS). Requires a completed study cycle >= nivel 4 QNQ; age 18-26 (30 if doutoramento nivel 8), max 35 during.
irs_jovem.study_requirement: Completed cycle >= nivel 4 QNQ (dupla certificacao / vocacional + estagio).
irs_jovem.exempt_semantics: exempt = min(exempt_pct * qualifying_income, cap_eur) for the applicable year.
irs_jovem.source: AT official folheto 'IRS Jovem 2022 e anos seguintes' (junho 2022), verbatim.

taxa_adicional_solidariedade.source: Artigo 68.º-A CIRS (assets/law/irs68a.md); bands unchanged since Lei 82-B/2014.
taxa_adicional_solidariedade.note: Added 2026-07-24; previously not modelled for this year, which understated tax above 80 000 EUR.

ias_eur.source: IAS 2023 = 480.43 (Portaria n.o 298/2022, de 16 de dezembro); cited in the AT IRS Jovem 2023 folheto.

categoria_a_specific_deduction_eur.source: Deducao especifica cat. A still frozen at 4104.00 for 2023 (Montepio, Doutor Financas); CIRS art. 25.

brackets.method: Art. 68 CIRS 2023. coleta computed cumulatively on marginal rates.
brackets.confirmation: CONFIRMED by Doutor Financas (taxas-de-irs) full 2023 table; corroborated by ACIAB/Santander (2nd escalao 21%, limits +5.1%).

Corrigido 2026-07-24: este campo seguia o teto do 8.º escalão do artigo 68.º (75 009 em 2022, 78 834 em 2023, 80 000 em 2024) — um número de OUTRO artigo, que só por coincidência acertou em 2024.

This is the last 5-year version before the 2025 reform (10 years, 100/75x3/50x3/25x3, flat 55xIAS, no study requirement, age 18-35). Study cycle >= nivel 4 QNQ still required in 2024; age 18-26 (30 doutoramento), max 35 during.
